description: This source file implements functionality for credential caching using Unix domain sockets in a Git-related software. It includes methods for starting a daemon, sending requests, and handling cache lifecycle operations, mainly for credential cache management.

methods.name: int connection_closed(int error)
methods.description: Determines if the connection has been closed based on the error code, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: int connection_fatally_broken(int error)
methods.description: Determines if the connection is broken in a way that cannot be recovered, based on error code, with platform-specific logic.

methods.name: int send_request(const char * socket,const struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Establishes a Unix socket connection and sends a request buffer, reading and outputting responses.

methods.name: void spawn_daemon(const char * socket)
methods.description: Starts the credential cache daemon process and verifies its startup.

methods.name: void do_cache(const char * socket,const char * action,int timeout,int flags)
methods.description: Performs cache actions such as get, store, or erase, managing connection, retries, and relay flags.

methods.name: char * get_socket_path(void)
methods.description: Determines the socket path, preferring a user directory or falling back to a XDG cache directory.

methods.name: void announce_capabilities(void)
methods.description: Announces credential cache capabilities to stdout.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_cache(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command handler for credential cache operations, parsing arguments and dispatching actions.
